title: Quantum Space Memory: Preregistered Cross-Job Information Persistence Tests on IBM Heron Transmons (Null Results and Erratum)
description:
Preregistered tests of whether superconducting transmon qubits retain information about a prior state preparation across separate execution sessions ("memory in space"). Contains the frozen preregistrations (committed before each run), layout selection, raw Qiskit counts with job IDs, positive controls and analysis scripts for IBM Heron r2.

Results: all preregistered primary tests are null. Spatial bath spectroscopy (ibm_kingston, job dbnc6ooqtr0c73acp00g): H0 under the preregistered rule; the largest deviation is z = 2.89, below the 3σ threshold (Holm-corrected minimum p = 0.057 over 15 tests). The TLS/T2* protocol is not a valid test: its two arms compile to identical circuits. Primary cross-job delta: Δ = +0.00023, p = 0.36; zero-IQ ground-state centroid shift Δ = −0.00069, p = 0.55; energy-matched control Δ = −0.00135, p = 0.29.

Erratum 2026-11-18: the original spectroscopy analysis printed "H1 SUPPORTED" because it used curve-fit errors instead of shot-noise errors; a later commit changed the decision rule after seeing the data. Version 0.2.0 restores the preregistered rule with binomial bootstrap errors. All numbers can be recomputed from the archived raw data with the included scripts.
